config.note: Fixed five consecutive previously unrun indices before v3 inference. Both arms share width three, bounded validated proposals, original user templates, reasoning-allowed value formatting, terminal handling and resource caps. The only between-arm change is LLM value evaluation versus a declared exhaustive exact-arithmetic reachability tool. The tool returns only reachability, not an expression, but is an oracle for this small domain. Results measure a hybrid tool-assisted system, not stronger unaided LLM reasoning. V1/v2 remain separate; all failures stay in the denominator.

seed_note: Python and NumPy are seeded locally; no provider-side deterministic seed is claimed.
